description: This Java source file defines the ShardRegions class, responsible for creating and retrieving shard region proxies within an Akka cluster sharding context. It manages actor references for policies, things, and connections, providing methods to initialize and access them.

classes.name: ShardRegions
classes.description: A final class responsible for creating and managing shard region proxies in an Akka cluster sharding setup. It provides methods to access proxies for policies, things, and connections, as well as to instantiate new proxies for specific shard regions.

methods.name: ShardRegions
methods.description: Private constructor initializing shard region proxies for policies, things, and connections using cluster configuration and actor system.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of ShardRegions with specified ActorSystem and ClusterConfig.

methods.name: policies
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef for the policies shard region proxy.

methods.name: things
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef for the things shard region proxy.

methods.name: connections
methods.description: Returns the ActorRef for the connections shard region proxy.

methods.name: startProxy
methods.description: Creates and returns a proxy ActorRef for a specified shard region name and cluster role. Does not cache the reference.
